releases.notes:
# 1.0.0 (beta)

- Ctrl+W toggles forward input while driving a Happy Ghast.
- Ctrl+W, backward movement, sneak/dismount, menus, focus loss and lost driver status cancel the latch.
- Preserves normal steering and vanilla movement packets.
- Client-only Fabric build for Minecraft 26.3 and Java 25; no Fabric API dependency.
- Automated logic/input tests and Fabric mixin transformation checks pass. Manual in-world flight verification pending.
